note: Raw search and graph hits require semantic screening; no gold-standard recall rate claimed.
original_paper_validation: Not performed in this recall stage; candidates are grounded in existing parsed structured records, not newly asserted experimental facts.
semantic_scope: Explicit selected rows were LLM-reviewed using full abstract and problem/mechanism summaries; unmatched graph/keyword hits stay unreviewed.

semantic_graph.meaning: Similarity is discovery evidence only, not inheritance, same-problem proof, or full-text verification. This scans the existing candidate-edge cache, not all pairs.

deduplication: Local exact canonical IDs and exact normalized titles checked; no title alias groups found in screened records. Conference entries without a verified arXiv mapping retain their conference identifier; fuzzy mirror merges need original identity checks.
provenance_limits: Up to 15 citation-neighbor evidence records and 10 semantic links retained per candidate. Citation graph and similarity graph remain distinct. Discovery is not proof of a scientific relationship.

baseline_local_coverage.meaning: Remaining baseline references may have PDFs elsewhere in workspace; this local-index scan does not drop them from the parent report.

search_fields: data.structured_summary.methods including mechanism and reported excerpts
priority_policy: P1 means a coverage gap worth verifying next, not a claim of scientific superiority. P0 is existing baseline; P2 expands method coverage; P3 is boundary-only.
